manus: GTA 6 just tied the highest Metacritic score of all time. It has a 99, from around 150 critic reviews. The only other game with a 99 is The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, from 1998. On OpenCritic, it sits at around 98 to 99. For comparison, GTA 4 got a 98, and GTA 5 got a 97. Do you think it deserves it? Comment below, and follow for more GTA 6.
